title: The Locality Gap: A Thermodynamic Law for Objective Facts
summary: Objective facts in quantum Darwinism are values recorded redundantly in many independently accessible fragments of the environment. Redundancy does not create additional logical information, so its thermodynamic meaning has remained unclear. We show that it creates an exact work asymmetry between controllers with different access architectures. For a record cloud $F$ and a partition $\mathcal{P}$ into blocks that cannot be jointly controlled, the reversible isothermal erasure penalty relative to a global controller is $k_{\mathrm{B}}T$ times the partition total correlation.
